Chapter 1278 29: Light

Chapter 1278 29: Light

Lin Yuan looked at the Eternal Painting his heart sensed.

It was vast and boundless, like a real 'source world.'

But Lin Yuan clearly felt that the gigantic painting's framework was set up.

Yet within the vast painting, many areas remained vague and blank, still unpainted.

"This is a painting that's not yet finished." Lin Yuan's expression was solemn.

If this colossal painting were fully completed, it would be a real 'source world.'

At that time, Master of Wushan relying on this grand painting could at least reach the level of a thirteenth-level lord.

At the height of time life, what is pursued is all related to one's own Great Dao, and Master of Wushan, having crossed into the thirteenth level through painting, would need to draw a complete 'source world' to progress further.

"Remarkable."

Lin Yuan carefully observed the Eternal Painting.

How vast and majestic is a source world? It's no longer a matter of size or area, but encompasses countless rule Daos.

To paint a source world is equivalent to creating a source world, and its difficulty is far greater than Lin Yuan cultivating the "Infinite Void" to the theoretical seventh level.

The ultimate goal of "Infinite Void" is Chaos Void, whereas the source world… although comparable in level with Chaos Void, the source world is more perfect.

The thirteenth-level time beings of Chaos Void have left many special places.

To compensate for the flaws of Chaos Void, but the source world has no such concerns.

Because the source world has no inherent flaws, it is nearly perfect.

"Though unfinished, it's enough for me."

Lin Yuan watched the colossal painting.

The painting itself is composed of endless runes.

Master of Wushan painted with runes to create a source world encompassing the universe.

[Your understanding defies the heavens; by observing the unknown grand painting, your comprehension of Rune Dao is enhanced...]

Lin Yuan's mind immersed in the boundless Eternal Painting, his entire being was elevating.

The essence of Rune Dao is a supportive Dao, capable of integrating with any cultivation system.

With runes, many originally unattainable or challenging feats become possible.

For instance, Lin Yuan's current development of particle worlds.

Initially, maintaining the existence of each particle world required some mental effort.

For Lin Yuan, whose goal is to develop endless Constant Sand Particle Worlds, this is unacceptable.

But Rune Dao solves this flaw, sustaining each particle world through rune operation without any mental input.

Who knows how much time has passed.

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes.

"How was it?"

The golden figure looked at Lin Yuan and asked.

"Very impactful."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The Eternal Painting had already imprinted deeply in his mind.

He could ponder over it at any time.

"That's all it took to impress you?"

The golden figure smiled.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan looked at the golden figure.

Their remark implied there were other benefits?

"Elder."

Lin Yuan immediately called out.

"Haha..." The golden figure smiled.

With his experience, even if called so by the Eternal Sons, it would be appropriate.

But Lin Yuan?

Lin Yuan's power was so overwhelming.

So overwhelming that the golden figure didn't even consider him a life below the Eternal Lord.

"What is the purpose of this trial space?" The golden figure asked.

"To cultivate a new Eternal Lord." Lin Yuan thought for a moment and replied.

This was also what the golden figure had told him initially.

The trial space was Master of Wushan's setup before the great change of heaven and earth.

It aimed to cultivate an Eternal Lord for this world after the disaster struck.

Only then could the 'demon' calamity be eradicated.

"Do you think the grand painting left by Master of Wushan can cultivate an Eternal Lord?"

The golden figure asked.

"This..."

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

The Eternal Painting left by Master of Wushan was profound and boundless.

Even other thirteenth-level time beings needed to comprehend it slowly.

For Lin Yuan, it was even more so.

Even stepping into the thirteenth level, he would continue to benefit from the grand painting.

But in essence, the grand painting didn't mention how to step into the thirteenth level.

Visit Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (МV-LЕМР-YR) fоr mоrе.

Even if fully comprehending this Eternal Painting, stepping into the thirteenth level...

Especially breaking through the time loop, it doesn't provide substantial help.

If one can't step into the thirteenth level, can't enhance the possibility of breaking the time loop.

This grand painting isn't very significant; it's not as beneficial as the addition of another cultivator in Lin Yuan's dissemination of Martial Tao.

At least it would strengthen the 'anchor' a bit.

"Actually, besides the magnificent grand painting heritage left by Master of Wushan, there's another heritage."

The golden figure looked at Lin Yuan, continuing: "The legacy of the Lord of Heaven Light."

"The Lord of Heaven Light?"

Lin Yuan's heart slightly trembled.

Whether Qingyun Sacred Mountain's records or the inheritances from other Free Three Realms powerhouses Lin Yuan obtained during his explorations.

All mentioned this Eternal Lord.

The Lord of Heaven Light was the first Eternal Lord to appear in this world.

Also the most mysterious Eternal Lord.

The reason for 'first appearance' was that no one knew when the Lord of Heaven Light became an Eternal Lord.

At the birth of the heavens and earth? Or even earlier?

No one knew.

All that was known was that when the Lord of Heaven Light first appeared before all beings, he was already an Eternal Lord.

It was precisely because of the Lord of Heaven Light that this world's cultivation system could flourish, and Rune Dao was rooted in the Lord of Heaven Light.

"Although the great Master of Wushan also has some experience in becoming an Eternal Lord, it must be acknowledged that compared to the Lord of Heaven Light, he's still lacking."

The golden figure continued: "If not for the Lord of Heaven Light, the current number of Eternal Lords would surely be halved."
